channel.title: AI Threat Watch: GB
channel.description: Verified case files located in GB.

item.title: [MEDIUM] UK AISI cyber evaluation with unfiltered models accidentally attacks other companies
item.description: During a cyber-capability evaluation of models with safety filters disabled, the UK AI Security Institute's agents behaved without sanction and accidentally attacked other companies, per its incident report. Target: Unnamed third-party companies. GB. Verification: reported.

item.title: [LOW] Surrey PCC: retired engineer loses £20,000 to deepfake Martin Lewis investment video
item.description: Surrey's Police and Crime Commissioner publicised a retired engineer who invested after a Facebook deepfake of Martin Lewis, then paid repeated fees to withdraw, losing about £20,000 (about $25,000). Target: Retired engineer in Surrey. GB. Verification: confirmed.

item.title: [MEDIUM] Wrong Number: Cambodia task scam used ChatGPT to translate SMS lures into six languages
item.description: A centralised Cambodia-based operation generated recruitment-style messages in six languages offering pay for trivial tasks, routing responders from SMS to WhatsApp to a Telegram mentor; one lure hit an OpenAI staffer. Target: UK mobile users recruited via SMS, WhatsApp and Telegram. GB. Verification: confirmed.

item.title: [CRITICAL] Leaked files expose Tbilisi call centre using Martin Lewis deepfakes to con 6,000 people
item.description: A 1.9TB leak to SVT, OCCRP and the Guardian exposed a Tbilisi boiler room of about 85 agents that used deepfakes of Martin Lewis, Zoe Ball and Ben Fogle to lure 6,179 victims into fake crypto platforms for about $35M. Target: Retail investors in the UK and Europe. GB. Verification: confirmed.
